title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
title_zh: 对抗性推测推理提升长程智能体

paragraphs.en: Speculative decoding has been treated purely as a systems optimization that speeds up large language model decoding without changing the model behavior. Under this view, the growing effort to train better draft models has been focused solely on acceptance rate. We argue that this view does not hold true for long-horizon agent reasoning. Measuring frontier open-weight models on complex agentic tasks with different speculative decoding approaches, we found that numerical noise grows within verification windows, and the draft acceptance results of the thinking process can change the output distribution of the model after 30 steps, thus noticeably influencing the reasoning accuracy of long-horizon agents in random directions. In this work, we improve the reasoning capability of target models by controlling such noise. While we cannot change the overall token distribution verified by the target model, we can encode critical reasoning with highest precision by training the draft model to be rejected. We identify these points in agent traces and train the draft model to favor adversarial preference. At inference the trained draft and the target part ways precisely at these decision points, verification restarts, so that critical thinking tokens are sampled from the target model and encoded under its least noisy conditions. This approach makes critical reasoning better indexed and more durable over a long horizon. On complex agentic coding benchmarks, our approach raises end-to-end success rate with no change to the target model or its output distribution. Our results recast the speculative decoding mechanism from a pure accelerator into an active allocator for context precision that improves the accuracy of long-horizon agents by training 0.06% to 0.28% of hosted parameters.

paragraphs.en: However, the theoretical guarantee is stated for an idealized target, a fixed function from a prefix to a distribution. Frontier models are not hosted that way. They are served with low-precision weights, quantized key-value (KV) caches and sparse attention, and their inference outputs are not bitwise-reproducible. In this regime, the target’s logits are a noisy quantity depending on how the computation is laid out, and is relevant to the draft acceptence length. We measure this directly by rerunning the same forward pass on an identical prefix and compare the top-k log-probabilities. On GLM-5.3 GLM-5-Team et al. (2026) with an 8-token DFlash verification block, the first slot of the block is exactly as noisy as single-token decoding. Beyond the first slot, the noise increases with each position in the block, by roughly 4% per slot, and large deviations grow faster still: by the last slot, log-probability shifts of more than 2 natural-log units (nats) are nearly twice as common as at the first. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 ( Xu et al. 2026 ; referred to in this study as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) with a 6-token DSPARK block shows the same pattern. Its absolute noise is about half that of GLM-5.3, but it grows at the same relative rate of roughly 4% per slot. Speculative verification is therefore lossless in distribution but not neutral in precision: where a token sits in a verification block determines how precisely the target encodes it.

paragraphs.en: This matters most for long-horizon agents. A software-engineering agent runs for dozens to hundreds of turns over thousands to millions of tokens. Every token it generates is encoded and committed to the KV cache and read back by everything that follows. Most of these tokens can carry higher noises without hurting future reasoning, but some are not, especially for those critical phrases in the thinking process where the model frames a decision in its thinking, for example, as a matter of principle and evidence, as a guess about what is likely or risky, or settling a confusion by guessing, reading, or running tests. In our audit of agentic coding traces, principle-, evidence-framed, or actual test-driven decisions took the correct side about twice higher than likelihood- or risk-guided reasoning. It is worth noting that these decisions are not necessarily persistent across the lifespan of the entire agentic task. Some wrong decisions can be flipped according to environmental feedback signals, while correct ones could be ignored in long-horizon tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 这对长时程的智能体最为重要。 一个软件工程智能体会在数千到数百万个 token 的规模上运行数十到数百轮。 它生成的每个 token 都会被编码并写入 KV 缓存，并被后续的所有计算读取。 其中大多数 token 即使携带较高噪声也不会损害后续推理，但有些则不然，尤其是思考过程中那些关键短语——模型在思考中据此框定决策，例如将其定性为基于原则和证据、对可能性或风险的猜测，或是通过猜测、阅读或运行测试来厘清困惑。 在我们对智能体编码轨迹的审查中，基于原则、证据或真实测试驱动的决策做出正确选择的比率，比基于可能性或风险引导的推理高出约一倍。 值得注意的是，这些决策在整个智能体任务的生命周期中并不一定是持久的。 一些错误的决策可以根据环境反馈信号被纠正，而正确的决策在长时程任务中却可能被忽略。

paragraphs.en: These observations suggest a lever that the lossless view hides. We cannot change the distribution the target verifies, and we do not want to. However, we can decide where each token comes from to re-allocate context precision by training the draft model to be rejected. An accepted draft token is committed with the precision of whichever slot verified it. A rejected token is resampled by the target, its entry is written at the head of a fresh verification block, and the verification of everything after it restarts from the least noisy slot. A draft that is rejected exactly at critical reasoning phrases therefore routes the decisions that matter through the target’s most precise path. It leaves the routine thinking tokens to ordinary acceleration.

paragraphs.en: We call this approach Adversarial Speculative Reasoning. We locate critical thinking in agent traces and build preference pairs between alternative decision framings. We then train the draft with direct preference optimization (DPO; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) in the reverse direction: the draft learns to prefer the framing the target should avoid. At inference, the draft and the target diverge precisely at these points, so the target’s own choice is committed through residual sampling and encoded precisely in the KV cache. The target model is unchanged, and so is the verification rule and its exactness guarantee. Only the draft model is changed and context precision is re-allocated. With this approach, we significantly improve long-horizon agent reasoning accuracy without hurting inference efficiency. For example, on DeepSWE Huang and Jiang (2026) , a benchmark of complex software-engineering tasks, Adversarial Speculative Reasoning raises the end-to-end success rate of GLM-5.3-nvfp4 from 60.6% to 67.6% (+7.0 points). It raises DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from 67.8% to 71.8% (+4.0 points) with the standard evaluation harness and environments. Overall, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种方法称为对抗性投机推理（Adversarial Speculative Reasoning）。 我们在智能体轨迹中定位批判性思维环节，并在不同的决策构建方式之间构建偏好对。 随后，我们以相反的方向用直接偏好优化（DPO；Rafailov et al., 2023）训练草稿模型：草稿模型学会偏好目标模型应避免的决策构建方式。 在推理时，草稿模型与目标模型恰恰在这些节点上产生分歧，因此目标模型自身的选择通过残差采样得以提交，并精确编码在 KV 缓存中。 目标模型保持不变，验证规则及其精确性保证也同样不变。 只有草稿模型被改变，上下文精度被重新分配。 借助这种方法，我们在不损害推理效率的前提下，显著提升了智能体长程推理的准确性。 例如，在复杂软件工程任务基准 DeepSWE（Huang and Jiang, 2026）上，对抗性投机推理将 GLM-5.3-nvfp4 的端到端成功率从 60.6% 提升至 67.6%（+7.0 个百分点）。 在标准评估框架与环境下，它将 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 从 67.8% 提升至 71.8%（+4.0 个百分点）。 总而言之，我们做出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: Speculative decoding and draft training. Speculative decoding Leviathan et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023) speeds up autoregressive generation. A cheap drafter proposes a block of tokens, the target model scores the whole block in one forward pass, and a modified rejection-sampling rule keeps the target’s output distribution exactly. Since then, most studies have aimed at more accepted tokens per verification step. Medusa Cai et al. (2024) attaches extra decoding heads to the target model. EAGLE Li et al. (2024) and EAGLE-3 Li et al. (2025) draft from the target’s hidden features. DFlash Chen et al. (2026b) drafts a whole block in parallel with a lightweight block-diffusion model. DistillSpec Zhou et al. (2024) distills the target into the draft to better align the two. In all of these methods the draft is trained to agree with the target, and the only metric is the decoding speed. We train the draft toward a different goal: to disagree with the target at chosen positions for stronger reasoning capability in long-horizon tasks.

paragraphs.en: Numerical nondeterminism in LLM inference. Production inference does not evaluate the idealized function that exactness guarantees assume. Yuan et al. (2025) show that under bfloat16 with greedy decoding, reasoning models can vary by several accuracy points and by thousands of tokens of response length across system configurations. He and Lab (2025) trace much of the run-to-run variation in serving engines to kernels that are not batch-invariant. Frontier models are also routinely served with quantized key-value caches Liu et al. (2024) and sparse attention Liu et al. (2025) , which add approximation errors on top. These studies treat precision as a property of the whole system and try to reduce or remove the variation. We instead measure how precision varies within a speculative verification block, and exploit that variation instead of eliminating it.

paragraphs.en: Critical tokens and preference optimization. Several studies find that a small subset of tokens decides where reasoning goes. Lin et al. (2025) identify and replace critical tokens that turn failed reasoning chains into correct ones, and train on them with token-level DPO. Wang et al. (2025) find that about 20% of chain-of-thought tokens have high entropy and act as forks between reasoning paths, and that restricting reinforcement-learning updates to these tokens matches or exceeds full updates. Both studies change the larger target model, while we apply direct preference optimization Rafailov et al. (2023) only to the draft, in reverse, so that the draft reliably proposes the framing the target should avoid. Li et al. (2026) found that even in a model routing system, critical reasoning in long-horizon tasks need to be handled by stronger models.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词元与偏好优化。 多项研究发现，仅一小部分词元就能决定推理的走向。Lin 等人 （2025）识别并替换那些能把失败的推理链变为正确推理链的关键词元，并使用词元级 DPO 对其进行训练。Wang 等人 （2025）发现，思维链中约 20% 的词元具有高熵，并充当推理路径之间的分叉点，而且仅对这些词元施加强化学习更新，其效果可媲美甚至超过全量更新。 这两项研究都改变较大的目标模型，而我们则将直接偏好优化（Rafailov 等人， 2023）仅应用于草稿智能体，且方向相反，使草稿智能体可靠地提出目标模型应当避免的表述方式。Li 等人 （2026）发现，即使在模型路由系统中，长程任务中的关键推理仍需由更强的模型来处理。

paragraphs.en: Exactness guarantees for speculative decoding are stated for an idealized target: a fixed function from a prefix to a next-token distribution. A served target is not that function. Its logits are produced by low-precision kernels whose result depends on how the computation is laid out, and a verify forward pass lays the computation out differently from ordinary decoding by processing a block of tokens in one launch, and each position attends to key-value entries that were computed in that same launch. This section asks whether and where that difference matters. We use two complementary measurements. The first isolates the numerical noise of a single forward pass at each position of a verification block (§ 3.2 ). The second follows a verify-written context through the rest of a long agent trajectory (§ 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 投机解码的精确性保证是针对一个理想化目标给出的：一个从前缀到下一个词元分布的固定函数。 实际服务的目标并不是那个函数。 它的 logits 由低精度内核产生，其结果取决于计算的组织方式，而验证前向传播以与普通解码不同的方式组织计算——它在一次启动中处理一个词元块，并且每个位置都会关注在同一次启动中计算出的键值条目。 本节讨论这种差异是否以及在何处产生影响。 我们使用两种互补的测量方法。 第一种方法隔离了验证块中每个位置上单次前向传播的数值噪声（§ 3.2）。 第二种方法追踪一个由验证写入的上下文在后续长智能体轨迹中的表现（§ 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: Error metric. For a position and two forward passes that should agree, we compare log-probabilities token by token. At each position we take the four most likely tokens under a reference pass, together with the token the trajectory actually emits, and record | Δ ​ log ⁡ p | = | log ⁡ p 1 ​ ( v ) − log ⁡ p 2 ​ ( v ) | |\Delta\log p|=|\log p_{1}(v)-\log p_{2}(v)| for each such token v v . Log-probabilities use the natural logarithm, so differences are in natural-log units ( nats ). A difference of 1 nat is a factor of e ≈ 2.7 e\approx 2.7 in probability, and 2 nats a factor of e 2 ≈ 7.4 e^{2}\approx 7.4 . We report the mean and the fraction of tokens whose difference exceeds 1, 2 or 3 nats. The tails matter because our agents sample at temperature 1 with top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 or 1.0 1.0 . In agentic reasoning, a shift of 1–2 nats in the emitted token’s log-probability changes whether that token lies inside the sampling nucleus in 12% of cases, 2–3 nats in 47%, and more than 3 nats in over 84%.

paragraphs.en: Sliding-window verification. Comparing a verification pass against a separate decoding request mixes two noise sources: the forward pass of decoding, and the independent prefill that rebuilds the prefix in each request. To exclude the latter, we hold the prefix fixed in memory and repeat only the forward decode pass. We first generate a reference trajectory by greedy single-token decoding, so that the tokens under test are the target’s own choices rather than the draft’s. For each position q q of the trajectory and each slot s s , we prefill the prompt and the trajectory up to the block’s anchor q − s q-s , write the next W W trajectory tokens into the verify block, and execute that same verify forward pass R = 4 R=4 times on the unchanged key-value cache. Row s s of each repetition gives the distribution at position q q computed from slot s s . For decoding, we prefill up to q q and execute the same single-token decode step R R times. Differences between repetitions then contain only the numerical nondeterminism of one forward pass on identical inputs. We measure 1631 positions on GLM-5.3 and 1294 on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, drawn from DeepSWE prompts with 6k–24k tokens of context.
paragraphs.zh: 滑动窗口验证。 将一次验证过程与单独的解码请求相比较，会混合两种噪声来源：解码的前向传递，以及在每个请求中重建前缀的独立预填充。 为了排除后者，我们将前缀固定在内存中，仅重复前向解码传递。 我们首先通过贪心的单令牌解码生成一条参考轨迹，使被测令牌是目标模型自身的选择，而非草稿模型的选择。 对于轨迹的每个位置 q q 和每个槽位 s s，我们预填充提示词以及轨迹至该区块的锚点 q − s q-s，将接下来的 W W 个轨迹令牌写入验证区块，并在未改变的键值缓存上执行相同的验证前向传递 R = 4 R=4 次。 每次重复的第 s s 行给出由槽位 s s 计算得到的位置 q q 处的分布。 对于解码，我们预填充至 q q，并执行相同的单令牌解码步骤 R R 次。 这样，各次重复之间的差异便仅包含在相同输入上单次前向传递的数值非确定性。 我们在 GLM-5.3 上测量了 1631 个位置，在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上测量了 1294 个位置，这些位置取自上下文长度为 6k–24k 令牌的 DeepSWE 提示词。

paragraphs.en: Following a verify-written context over a long horizon. Method 1 measures one forward pass. An agent, however, keeps every token it writes and reads it back for the rest of the task. In each GLM-5.3 DeepSWE trajectory we select the assistant turn with the longest reasoning and call it the source turn (median of 9k tokens, after a median of 45k-token prefix). We write the source turn’s tokens into the key-value cache for two scenarios: (A) through DFlash blockwise-verification, with every source token forced and accepted through its verify slot; or (B) through single-token decoding. The token sequence is identical on both paths; only the computation that wrote its key-value entries differs. Reusing that cache, we then score the remainder of the real trajectory teacher-forced, up to 128k further tokens (a median of 95 subsequent assistant turns), and record the log-probability of every assistant token; tool outputs stay in the context but are not scored. Each path is built twice ( A , A ′ A,A^{\prime} and B , B ′ B,B^{\prime} ). Because | A − B | |A-B| contains the variance of both paths, we compare the paths through their own build-to-build deviations, | A − A ′ | |A-A^{\prime}| versus | B − B ′ | |B-B^{\prime}| , and count tokens whose log-probability moves by more than 1, 2, 3 or 4 nats. We ran this study on 96 distinct tasks and scored 6.38M scored assistant tokens per build.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shows the same pattern. paragraphs.en: Why the noise grows. We fix the input tokens and KV cache for repeated decoding and verifications inside the forward passes. A token at slot s s attends to the key-value entries of slots 0 , … , s − 1 0,\dots,s-1 , and those entries are computed in the same launch rather than read from the cache. Each repetition recomputes them with its own rounding, and slot s s inherits the accumulated variation of all earlier slots. Slot 0 reads only cached entries, which is why it matches decoding. Verification is therefore exact in distribution but not uniform in precision: the further into a block a distribution is computed, the noisier it is.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the two measurements give a simple picture. Speculative verification preserves the target’s distribution but its precision is not uniform, and the loss of precision is structured: it grows along the verification block, concentrates in large deviations, and the encoding noises on thinking tokens can surface far downstream. This has no consequence for most tokens, which are routine and robust to small perturbations. It matters for the few tokens at which an agent commits to a decision, because those tokens shape every turn that follows. Standard speculative decoding is indifferent to where such tokens land: whether a decision is committed at the precise head of a block or at its noisy tail depends only on how many draft tokens happened to be accepted before it.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这两项测量给出了一个简单的图景。 推测式验证保持了目标模型的分布，但其精度并不均匀，而且精度的损失是有结构的：它沿验证块逐渐增大，集中在大偏差上，并且作用于思考型词元的编码噪声可能在很远的下游显现出来。 这对大多数词元没有影响，因为它们是常规的，并且对小扰动具有鲁棒性。 但它对少数词元很重要，在这些词元处智能体做出决策承诺，因为这些词元塑造了之后所有的轮次。 标准的推测式解码对这类词元落在哪里漠不关心：一个决策究竟是在块的无噪头部被承诺，还是在它的有噪尾部被承诺，只取决于之前碰巧有多少个草稿词元被接受。

paragraphs.en: The position at which a token is committed is not determined by the target, however; it is decided by the draft. If the draft proposes something the target rejects, the target resamples that position itself, and the next verification block starts from slot 0. A draft that is reliably rejected at decision points therefore moves those decisions to the most precise slot and resets the precision of the tokens that follow, without changing the output distribution. Section 4 turns this observation into a training objective for the draft.

paragraphs.en: Section 3 showed that a verification block is exact in distribution but not uniform in precision. Slot 0 is as precise as single-token decoding, and every later slot is noisier. Which slot a token is committed from is decided by the draft, through how many of its proposals the target accepts. This section introduces how we turned the draft into a tool for controlling that choice and re-allocating the context precision. We train the draft adversarially . At the points where a model commits to a decision in its thinking, the draft learns to propose the undesirable behavior. The target rejects that proposal, writes the decision itself, and the tokens after it start from a fresh verification block. Because distribution is exact, the trained draft cannot change what the target would sample. It changes only where blocks end and which tokens are committed with higher precision into the KV cache. In this section, § 4.1 states what a draft can and cannot control. § 4.2 defines the decision points and the preferences we train on. § 4.3 describes the training data and objective, § 4.4 shows the two unbiased draft models are made trainable.

paragraphs.en: This gives a handle that standard speculative decoding models ignored. paragraphs.en: An agent’s reasoning is mostly routine. The tokens that matter are the few at which it commits: it settles on how to read an ambiguous requirement, decides whether to test an edge case, or signs off on a change. We locate these points through the committing sentence , the sentence in the reasoning that confirms observations, states next steps, and commits decisions. A judge labels each segment of reasoning and returns the committing sentence verbatim (at most 35 words), which fixes the decision point in the token sequence. The judge is the target model itself, so no stronger external model is involved. Each preference splits behavior at a decision point into a desirable and an undesirable side. paragraphs.en: Decision frame. Agent reasoning regularly reaches points of confusion: different readings of a requirement or implementation strategies are both plausible, and the agent has to commit to one. Agents resolve these points in a few recurring modes. A principle frame derives the choice from the task specification or from interface semantics, and an evidence frame cites something observed in the repository or previous test. A likely frame guesses which option is more likely to be expected in hidden tests, a risk frame picks the conservative option, and a simpler frame picks the option that needs less code changes. Analyzing reasoning traces, we find that the mode predicts whether the decision is correct: on GLM-5.3, decisions made in a principle or evidence frame are correct about 70% of the time, against 36% for likely and risk frames. Principle and evidence are therefore the preferred frames; likely, risk and simpler are adversarial.
paragraphs.zh: 决策框架。 智能体推理经常会遇到困惑点：对某个需求或实现策略的不同解读都看似合理，而智能体必须选定其中一种。 智能体在几种反复出现的模式下解决这些困惑点。 原则框架从任务规范或接口语义中推导出选择，证据框架则引用在代码仓库或先前测试中观察到的内容。 可能性框架猜测哪个选项更可能符合隐藏测试的预期，风险框架选择保守的选项，简化框架选择需要更少代码改动的选项。 通过分析推理轨迹，我们发现该模式可以预测决策是否正确：在 GLM-5.3 上，以原则或证据框架做出的决策约有 70% 是正确的，而可能性和风险框架仅为 36%。 因此，原则和证据是首选框架；可能性、风险和简化属于对抗性框架。

paragraphs.en: Behavior preferences. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash writes terser reasoning, and two thirds of its likely-framed sentences carry no lexical marker of the decision frames analyzed above. Its failures concentrate instead in decisions taken without validation: it signs off on a case, or trusts unreliable observation, without running actual tests to validate its reasoning. We therefore define a preference over the behavior around actually running tests on whether the agent runs a test before it commits to a plan or reacts to environment signals. The decision points are the moments at which a check is warranted: before committing to a plan, upon receiving a tool returning a failure or other unexpected output, and right after the reasoning raises a new scenario that the code may not handle or the task description did not specify clearly. At such a point the agent can construct and run a test, either to decide between the options in front of it or to find out what caused an anomaly in the environment before deciding how to handle it. It can also move on without that evidence, by only reading or editing files, or by questioning or dismissing the case in its reasoning. We found that testing is the more reliable side that leads to more correct behaviors. We label each continuation by the tool call issued after the thinking process. A continuation that executes a test or a script is labeled preferred , and one that issues only other commands is labeled adversarial .

paragraphs.en: Direction. A draft trained on preferences in the preferred direction would favor the side leading to correct reasoning. Recent work tunes a draft toward faithful responses in this way and relaxes verification so that the draft can steer the output Chen et al. (2026a) . We keep verification exact and train the adversarial draft in the reverse direction: its chosen side is the undesirable one (likely, risk or simpler frames on GLM-5.3; not running the tests on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash), so that at a decision point it invites rejection and residual sampling. Because rejection sampling is left intact, the draft cannot make the target produce more desirable reasoning and the target produces it exactly as often as it would without speculation. What changes is how that reasoning is encoded. The trained draft model places little mass on the preferred tokens, so when the target does produce one, it is more likely to come from residual sampling after a rejection than from an accepted draft block. The resampled token then becomes slot 0 of the next verify block, the most precise slot (§ 3.3 ), and the reasoning that follows it starts from a fresh block. Undesirable tokens, which the draft proposes, are more often accepted inside a block and computed from its noisier later slots. We hypothesize that over a long horizon an agent holds on more easily to decisions committed at higher precision than to those with noisier key-value states, so that preferred decisions weigh more in long-horizon reasoning.

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DSPARK. The DSPARK draft has about 14.3B parameters, 13.6B of them in FP4 routed experts, and its released implementation uses inference-only kernels. We port it to differentiable PyTorch operations, matching the reference kernels to within 10 − 7 10^{-7} per expert and 3–5% per stage output. We train the attention projections, norms, hyper-connections, attention sinks and the draft’s bigram head (449M parameters) and keep the routed experts and the input projection frozen. Weights stored in FP8 are trained with quantization-aware training (QAT): the forward pass fake-quantizes them in their deployed block format ( 32 × 32 32\times 32 blocks with power-of-two scales), the gradient passes straight through, and the exported draft is re-quantized to the same format, so the deployed draft computes exactly the function that was evaluated. Reference log-probabilities are precomputed with the original draft. Figure 3 (b) shows which parts of the draft are trained.

paragraphs.en: The method rests on three claims, and we test one per subsection. First, a draft model can be trained to prefer the undesirable side of a decision while its agreement with the target elsewhere is unchanged (§ 5.1 ). Second, serving the target model with that draft improves its results on long-horizon coding tasks (§ 5.2 ). Third, the adversarial draft does not slow decoding (§ 5.3 ). Throughout, the two targets are GLM-5.3-nvfp4 with its DFlash2 draft and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with its DSPARK draft with exact verification, so a draft can change which tokens are proposed but not the distribution of the tokens emitted.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法基于三个论断，我们在每个小节中分别验证其中一个。 首先，可以训练一个草稿模型使其偏向决策中不可取的一侧，同时其在其他方面与目标模型的一致性保持不变（§ 5.1）。 其次，用该草稿为目标模型提供服务，可提升其在长程编码任务上的结果（§ 5.2）。 第三，对抗性草稿不会减慢解码速度（§ 5.3）。 在整个过程中，两个目标模型分别是 GLM-5.3-nvfp4 及其 DFlash2 草稿，以及 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 及其 DSPARK 草稿，均采用精确验证，因此草稿只能改变被提议的词元，而不能改变所输出词元的分布。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a trained draft by the fraction of pairs from tasks unseen in training on which the draft’s windowed reward (§ 4.3 ) is higher for the chosen side, namely held-out preference accuracy . An untrained draft scores 0.5 by construction. What training costs in acceptance is measured separately, in § 5.3 : each trained draft model is compared with its untrained version slot by slot on the same tokens (Figure 5 (c, d)). On GLM-5.3 we hold out 6 of the 29 tasks (619 pairs); on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash we hold out 10% of the tasks (719 pairs for running tests). Each preference is trained in both directions: a preferred draft favors the desirable side, an adversarial draft the undesirable one. Alongside the two preferences we deploy (§ 4.2 ), we train two reference preferences on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash that we do not use, to mark what a draft cannot learn: how long the model thinks, and whether the decision leads to correct outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过「held-out preference accuracy」（留出偏好准确率）来评估训练后的草稿，即在训练中未见的任务所对应的配对中，草稿的窗口化奖励（§ 4.3）在所选一侧更高的比例。 未训练的草稿按构造得分为 0.5。 训练在接收率上的代价另行测量，见 § 5.3：将每个训练后的草稿模型与其未训练版本在相同的 token 上逐槽位比较（图 5 (c, d)）。 在 GLM-5.3 上，我们留出 29 个任务中的 6 个（619 对）；在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上，我们留出 10% 的任务（运行测试用 719 对）。 每种偏好都以两个方向进行训练：一个偏好性草稿偏向理想的一侧，一个对抗性草稿偏向不理想的一侧。 除了我们部署的两个偏好（§ 4.2）之外，我们还在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上训练了两个不使用的参考偏好，用以标示草稿无法学到的东西：模型思考的时长，以及该决策是否带来正确的结果。

paragraphs.en: In evaluation, we adopt the draft models that actually learned the preference. Figure 4 puts the two preferences we proposed next to the two reference preferences. Whether the model runs its tests, and in which frame it commits to a decision, are learned in both directions: 0.83 and 0.85 for running tests, 0.59 and 0.635 for the decision frame. We found that whether a decision is right is closer to unlearnable by the small draft model, since it requires stronger reasoning capability. The best of 36 forward and 12 adversarial configurations reach 0.61 and 0.57 on 92 and 128 pairs, inside the confidence interval of chance, and the medians are 0.52 and 0.46. Thinking length sits in between, 0.54 forward and 0.65 adversarial. The reference preferences showed that a draft model can pick up how a decision is phrased and what the model does next, but is not strong enough to learn semantic correctness. We therefore train only preferences of the first kind, which is sufficent for our adversarial speculation design. The draft does not have to know which side is right, only to propose the framing the target rejects.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估中，我们采用真正学到了偏好的草稿模型。 图 4 将我们提出的两个偏好与两个参考偏好放在一起对比。 模型是否运行其测试、以及在哪个框架下做出决策承诺，这两个方向都是可学习的：运行测试的得分为 0.83 和 0.85，决策框架的得分为 0.59 和 0.635。 我们发现，一个决策是否正确对小型草稿模型来说更接近于不可学习，因为它需要更强的推理能力。 在 36 种前向配置和 12 种对抗配置中，最好的配置在 92 对和 128 对上分别达到 0.61 和 0.57，处于随机水平的置信区间之内，中位数分别为 0.52 和 0.46。 思考长度则介于两者之间，前向为 0.54，对抗为 0.65。 参考偏好表明，草稿模型能够学会决策的表述方式以及模型接下来的行为，但其能力不足以学会语义上的正确性。 因此我们只训练第一类偏好，这对我们的对抗性投机设计已经足够。 草稿模型无需知道哪一方是正确的，只需提出目标模型会拒绝的那种框架即可。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the adversarial draft models on two agentic coding benchmarks. On DeepSWE , the agent receives a repository and a task description, works in a mini-swe-agent harness with shell access, and is graded by hidden tests; we report the fraction of the 113 tasks whose all hidden tests pass. On NL2Repo-Bench Ding et al. (2025) , the agent receives a requirements document and an empty workspace and has to build a multi-module Python library from scratch; the 104 generated repositories are graded against the upstream project’s pytest suite, and we report the mean test pass rate. To avoid reward hacking, we prevented internet connection for the development workspace. Both benchmarks run for hundreds of turns per task, with contexts that grow past 200k tokens, so they exercise the long-horizon regime. For each target we compare two servers that differ only in the draft: the pretrained draft ( base , standard speculative decoding) and the adversarial draft of § 5.1 . Everything else is held fixed: the target weights, the serving stack, exact verification, the sampling parameters, and the agent harness. Each configuration is tested five times independently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个智能体编程基准上评估对抗性草稿模型。 在 DeepSWE 上，智能体接收一个代码仓库和任务描述，在带有 shell 访问权限的 mini-swe-agent 环境中工作，并由隐藏测试进行评分；我们报告 113 个任务中所有隐藏测试均通过的任务比例。 在 NL2Repo-Bench（Ding 等人） （2025）上，智能体接收一份需求文档和一个空工作区，必须从零开始构建一个多模块 Python 库；生成的 104 个仓库依据上游项目的 pytest 测试套件进行评分，我们报告平均测试通过率。 为避免奖励作弊，我们禁止了开发工作区的网络连接。 两个基准的每个任务都要运行数百轮，上下文长度会超过 20 万个 token，因此它们考验的是长时程场景。 对于每个目标模型，我们比较两个仅在草稿上不同的服务器：预训练草稿（base，标准投机解码）与 §5.1 的对抗性草稿。 其余一切保持不变：目标模型权重、服务栈、精确验证、采样参数以及智能体运行环境。 每种配置都独立测试五次。

paragraphs.en: We found the adversarial draft raises the pass rate of both targets models on both tasks. Figure 5 (a, b) shows every run. On DeepSWE, GLM-5.3-nvfp4 served with the adversarial draft passes 67.6% of tasks against 60.6% with its unbiased draft, a gain of 7.0 points (95% CI 2.6 to 11.4). paragraphs.en: Speculative decoding has been typically viewed purely as a systems optimization to improve the decoding speed since rejection sampling does not change the target distribution. We argue that the draft can decide what tokens in the context are encoded more accurately. An adversarial draft model utilizes this feature to improve reasoning capability. At decision points it proposes reasoning draft that the target model should reject, so the target encodes critical decisions more precisely from the start of a verification block, while everywhere else the draft stays an ordinary high-acceptance draft. With adversarial draft models, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash gain significantly improved pass rate on DeepSWE and NL2Repo-Bench across independent runs without changing the output distribution of the target model. We take this as evidence that speculative decoding is more than an acceleration approach. By training the draft model to be a context precision re-allocator, the long-horizon agent reasoning capability of a large language model can be significantly improved.

sents.zh: 在决策点上，它会提出目标模型应当拒绝的推理草稿，使目标模型从验证块一开始就更精确地编码关键决策，而在其他地方草稿仍保持为普通的可高接受度的草稿。

sents.en: With adversarial draft models, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash gain significantly improved pass rate on DeepSWE and NL2Repo-Bench across independent runs without changing the output distribution of the target model.
sents.zh: 使用对抗性草稿模型后，GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 DeepSWE 和 NL2Repo-Bench 上跨独立运行的通过率显著提升，且不改变目标模型的输出分布。

sents.en: We take this as evidence that speculative decoding is more than an acceleration approach.
sents.zh: 我们将此视为投机解码不仅仅是一种加速方法的证据。

sents.en: By training the draft model to be a context precision re-allocator, the long-horizon agent reasoning capability of a large language model can be significantly improved.
sents.zh: 通过将草稿模型训练为上下文精度重分配器，可以显著提升大语言模型的长程智能体推理能力。
